sections.chapter_title: Controller area network with flexible data rate (FDCAN)
sections.section_title: FDCAN extended message ID filter element
sections.text_helper: Section 71.4.23 "FDCAN extended message ID filter element" in chapter 71 (Controller area network with flexible data rate (FDCAN)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 3678.
sections.section_content:
Up to 64 filter elements can be configured for 29-bit extended IDs. When accessing an
Extended message ID filter element, its address is the filter list extended start address
FDCAN_XIDFC.FLESA plus two times the index of the filter element (0 … 63).
